title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（木村定雄研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Kimura Sadao)
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn basic skills for planning, designing, constructing, and maintaining underground infrastructure.
(2) learn basic skills for analyzing changes in society, creating a desirable environment, and promoting sustainability.
advice:
This is a project that relates to underground space engineering.

Students design project themes by themselves and solve the problems of their choice.
or
Students design project themes by themselves and work on those themes.
or
The professor introduces some research topics, from which students select a theme of interest, and aim to solve a problem in that theme.

Precautions
450 hours or more of total study time are necessary for this course.
books: Appropriate references are assigned based on students’ progress.
requiredKnowledge: Students must have a basic knowledge of civil engineering and engineering ethics.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Students can fully explain reasonable construction and advanced maintenance techniques for underground structures.
(2) Students can do experiments, analyses, and investigations fully by themselves.
(3) Students can give presentations, fully report their results, and discuss their outcomes freely.
(4) Students act in full accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Students can understand reasonable construction and advanced maintenance techniques for underground structures.
(2) Students can perform experiments, analyses, and investigations with graduate students.
(3) Students can present and report their results and discuss them.
(4) Students act in accordance with engineering ethics.

lessons.content:
1) A research topic is set.
2) A literature survey is conducted.
3) Undergraduate students receive advice in
seminars.
4) Presentations and papers are contributed
to academic societies.

1) Research activities continue.
2) A bachelor's thesis is written, presented,
 and defended in an open hearing.
